function.name: HBITMAP_UserUnmarshal
function.signature: unsigned char * __RPC_USER HBITMAP_UserUnmarshal(ULONG *flags, unsigned char *buffer, HBITMAP *bmp)
function.header_comment:
/******************************************************************************
 *           HBITMAP_UserUnmarshal (combase.@)
 *
 * Unmarshals a bitmap from a buffer.
 *
 * PARAMS
 *  pFlags   [I] Flags. See notes.
 *  pBuffer  [I] Buffer to marshal the clip format from.
 *  phBmp    [O] Address that receive the unmarshaled bitmap.
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  The end of the marshaled data in the buffer.
 *
 * NOTES
 *  Even though the function is documented to take a pointer to an ULONG in
 *  pFlags, it actually takes a pointer to a USER_MARSHAL_CB structure, of which
 *  the first parameter is an ULONG.
 *  This function is only intended to be called by the RPC runtime.
 */
